property_summary: For every non-empty _tos array and any callee address, the reference C.transfer(...) always returns true (it ignores failures of low-level calls), but the mutant returns false if any low-level call returns false — so there exists a callee that makes the mutant return false while the reference still returns true.
change_summary: Capture and check the boolean success returned by the low-level call and return false if any call fails, altering the function's returned value for some inputs.
